pages.text: Use $(thing)Offset +$() to angle the stabilizers. Their beams push the disc sideways and it spins.$(br2)Each degree adds $(num)400 rpm$(). The stabilizers move 1 degree per second, up to $(num)15$().

Output grows with the $(thing)square$() of the spin: about $(num)200,000 RF/t$() at 4,000 rpm.$(br2)Above $(num)4,000 rpm$() (offset 10) the ring takes stress. See $(l:safety/failures)Overspin$().$(br2)Rotation burns no mass.
